entities.summary: The Safa Mosque, also known as the  Safa Shahouri Mosque, is a mosque located at Ponda within Goa, India. The mosque has a complex consisting of garden and fountains. The terracotta tile roof accommodates a rectangular prayer hall. Completed in the 16th century, the mosque is an ASI-protected Monument of National Importance in Goa.
